title: Verdier trace classes commute with specialization
statement:
Use the finite coefficient and specialization conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions] and [def-trf-deformation-specialization]. Let $c:C\to X\times_kX$ be a correspondence between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and let $\widetilde c:\widetilde C\to\widetilde X\times_D\widetilde X$ lift it, with special fibre $b=\widetilde c_0$. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, and assume that $\operatorname{sp}_{\widetilde X}K\in D^b_{ctf}(\widetilde X_0,A)$ and that all correspondences and dualizing complexes used are admissible. Then for every $u:c_2^*K\to c_1^!K$,
$$\operatorname{sp}_{\operatorname{Fix}(\widetilde c)}\bigl(\operatorname{Tr}_c(u)\bigr)=\operatorname{Tr}_{b}\bigl(\operatorname{sp}_{\widetilde c}u\bigr).$$
Here $\operatorname{Tr}$ is the Verdier trace class of [def-trf-trace-class], the fixed schemes are those of [def-trf-fixed-scheme], and the specialization on Borel--Moore sections is that of [def-trf-deformation-specialization]. No properness of $c$, $\widetilde c$, $X$ or their fixed schemes is assumed, and no invertibility of $u$ is assumed.
